/// <summary>
/// The contract of <see cref="ShopLocalizationEn"/>, with one member per text.
/// Every language in <c>[assembly: SupportedLanguages]</c> has a set that implements it next to <see cref="CodeChops.Idioma.ILocalizationSet"/>, named with its language as suffix.
/// A language without a set, or a set without a text, is a build error rather than a fallback at run time.
/// Each set is registered automatically, so there's nothing to register.
/// </summary>
[CodeChops.Idioma.Internals.LocalizationContract]
public interface IShopLocalization
{
    /// <inheritdoc cref="ShopLocalization.Checkout"/>
